notes: Exactly FOUR original main limbs total: TWO large articulated FRONT PINCERS and TWO smaller pointed REAR SUPPORTS. Preserve the separate small ivory mouthparts/mandibles and original pale head spurs as head parts, not extra walking legs. Keep the pale BLUE/GRAY angular carapace plates, dark inner body/joints, ivory pincer tips and dark rear points. prompt: Draw the entire two-direction animation sheet for existing game creature MON-158-0 from these two identity references. Image 1 is its canonical FRONT at rest, image 2 is its old approximate rear and may be misleading. Preserve the exact anatomy and colors in image 1. Exactly FOUR original main limbs total: TWO large articulated FRONT PINCERS and TWO smaller pointed REAR SUPPORTS. Preserve the separate small ivory mouthparts/mandibles and original pale head spurs as head parts, not extra walking legs. Keep the pale BLUE/GRAY angular carapace plates, dark inner body/joints, ivory pincer tips and dark rear points. Compact low scuttling crawl using the existing rear supports and foreclaw contacts; the two pincers remain pincers, never human hands or two extra legs. No additional middle legs, six/eight-legged redesign, tail, wings, new face, flat ivory body or equipment copied from the other reference. Rigid shell keeps its scale and shape. Correct directional anatomy where necessary. Use fixed slightly elevated square-grid camera. EXACTLY FOUR columns and FOUR rows of equal cells, sixteen complete figures. FIRST TWO ROWS: eight poses all walking TOWARD the camera, down the screen. LAST TWO ROWS: eight poses all traveling AWAY, up the screen, viewed from behind. The rear must show true back or tail, not face, chest, or a flipped front. Preserve equipment on the same anatomical side and respect occlusion. Each two-row block is a short continuous cycle: first row support A, load A, swing B, settle B; second row support B, load B, swing A, settle A. For no-leg creatures interpret these as alternating travel phases of their original body. Keep the same scale, silhouette and head position, small grounded motion where appropriate. All 16 separate figures are drawn whole, centered and fully inside their respective cells, with generous gutters and outside margins. No text, lines, ground, shadows, white matte, glow or particles. Genuine transparent alpha outside every silhouette. Dark matte pixel clusters and original materials.
